paragraphs.text: Section one.
You will hear a woman talking to an estate agent on the phone.
First, you have some time to look at questions one to seven on page two.
You'll see that there is an example that has been done for you. On this occasion only, the conversation relating to this will be played first.
Pearson's Estate Agents. Can I help you?
Yes, good morning. I'd like to register with your agency.
Oh, yes. Okay. Did you want to rent a property or buy one?
Buy.
Okay. Right. I'll just get a registration form.
Right. So in which area are you hoping to find a property?
In the Huddersfield area.
The buyer is looking for property in the Huddersfield area, so Huddersfield has been written in the space.
Now we shall begin. You should answer the questions as you listen because you will not hear the recording a second time. Listen carefully and answer questions one to seven.
Pearson's Estate Agents. Can I help you?
Yes, good morning. I'd like to register with your agency.
Oh, yes. Okay. Did you want to rent a property or buy one?
Buy.
Okay. Right. I'll just get a registration form.
Right. So in which area are you hoping to find a property?
In the Huddersfield area.
Fine. I'll just take some personal details, if I may. Uh, you are?
Mary King.
Fine. And can I have your present address, please?
It's 59 Franklin Avenue.
Is that spelled L-I-N at the end?
No, it's F-R-A-N-K-L-Y-N.
Oh, right. Okay. And the town?
Barnsley.
Right. And do you happen to know your postcode?
It's TY26OS.
Is that T for Tango?
Yes, it is.
Fine. Um, now obviously, I'll put you on our mailing list for property details, but sometimes we might want to contact you quickly. So can you give me a phone number?
Yes. My number's 019488536.
And is that daytime or evening or both?
No, it's an office number, so from eight in the morning to three thirty. Do you need an evening number as well?
No, not really. Thanks. Okay. Well, now I'll take some details about the kind of property you're looking for. Uh, was it a house or a flat?
House.
Okay. Any particular kind?
Yes. I don't really like modern houses very much. I'd like something traditional, really.
Yes. Okay. And how big? Three bedrooms? Four bedrooms?
Yes, that sort of size. I wouldn't want anything with less than three, I think.
Right. Got that.
Uh, anything else as far as the property itself is concerned?
I'd really like to find somewhere with central heating. I know a lot of those cottages still just have fireplaces, but I don't really want that, and those electric heaters are very expensive to run.
You're right, they are. Okay, I'll make a note of that. Anything else? What about outside? Do you need a garden, for example?
Well, that'd be nice, but it's not essential. But one thing I really must have is a garage. I know that a lot of older places don't have one of those either, but-
Well, that's true, but we'll do our best. I've made a note.
Right. And what about the location?
If possible, I'd like something in a village, but not too far away from the town.
Right.
Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions eight to ten on page three.
Now listen and answer questions eight to ten.
Now, what about the price? What's your budget?
I could go up to a 12000 pounds, not more, but if I can get something suitable for less, I'd rather, of course.
And will you be applying for a loan from the bank to help cover the cost?
I've already done that, and the bank's approved it.
Oh, good. Uh, could you just give me a few details? What's the name of your bank?
York.
Right. And which branch is that?
It's in Park Square. I used to live in that area, and then when I moved, I kept my account there.

That's excellent. You'll be able to go straight ahead then. That's a real advantage when you're bidding for property. Now, we've got a few things on the books already that you might be interested in. Shall I put the details in the post?
Well, actually, I can collect them myself. My office is quite near yours. That would probably be easier, I mean...
That is the end of section one. You now have half a minute to check your answers.
